name: Natsu, Mei to.
source:
It was my first homecoming in 5 years.
My two nieces had grown up beautifully.

We gradually became reacquainted,
and the burdens of my life dissipated like clouds in the sun.

My mind returns often to that time...

That summer----------------
Those good days with my nieces.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE178574.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是我五年来第一次回家。
我的两个侄女已经长大得很漂亮了。

我们渐渐地重新熟悉起来，
我生活中的重担就像阳光下的云一样消散了。

我的思绪常常回到那个时候……

那年夏天----------------
和侄女们一起度过的美好时光。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE178574.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
